scope.summary: OPTIONAL adapter (some ops remote) ML filter rows as StudioLiveFilter entries, provider=adapter-backed/optional: ML Smart Portrait (happiness/surprise/anger/facial-age/gaze/hair-thickness/head-direction/light-direction), ML Super-Resolution / Super Zoom (synthesize detail to recover resolution), ML Makeup Transfer (eye/mouth makeup from another open image), ML Photo Restoration (scratches/contrast/damage), ML Harmonization (match color/tone of one layer to another, intensity refine), ML Landscape Mixer (blend landscape refs/presets), ML Depth Blur (depth-based env blur + haze/temperature), ML Color Transfer (reference palette + brightness/saturation/luminescence). Each EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE without adapter; headless/quiet provider calls. MARK optional.
acceptance_criteria: ML Smart Portrait, Super-Resolution, Makeup Transfer, Photo Restoration, Harmonization, Landscape Mixer, Depth Blur, Color Transfer; optional adapter; quiet remote calls
proof_targets: remote-ML optional-lane registration + unavailable-state + quiet test
expected_tests: test: remote/portrait ML rows registered as optional adapter-backed effect_kind; EFFECT_ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE without adapter; remote calls headless/quiet + attributable

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Remote/portrait ML filter rows dropped from the catalog.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
